content.title: FROG Q2 Deep Dive: Cloud, Security, and AI Drive Expansion Amid Hybrid Demand Shift
content.summary: Software development tools maker JFrog (NASDAQ:FROG) reported Q2 CY2025 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 23.5% year on year to $127.2 million. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was better than expected at $128 million at the midpoint, 1.6% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.18 per share was 10.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
